# SCALES: pct: 1 = 1 percent; ratio and share_0_1, share_m1_1: a raw fraction (0.01 = 1 percent); bps: 1 = 0.01 percent; price: USDT per coin; price_delta: USDT per coin, a difference of two prices; usd: US dollars; coins_qty: an amount of coins; per_second: a rate; score: a bounded scale named in unit_text; timestamp_us: microseconds since 1970; metric_unit: the unit of the value named in a percent table row's metric field
# EMPTY: an empty value is a row with value_kind 0, NaN and an empty_reason word; never read it as 0. empty_when lists the reasons SEEN in the binary (181 days) and the card's list

# CARD_CHECK (the year words: team/LAB/code/rawcheck/layer_register.py 2542a17e lines 9 to 16, the first that holds): PARKED the owner parked it; REBUILD on the build list as empty or wrong, or computation NOT_RELIABLE: do not use; DIFFERS meaning differs from its name: never read it by its name; CLEAN computation RELIABLE and meaning DEFINED: usable as it is; LIMITS RELIABLE, DEFINED_WITH_OPEN: usable, read its open note; MEANING_NEXT computed right, meaning not tested yet; NOT_CHECKED neither check done. Add-ons: CLEAN the card's checklist PASS and signed; CLEAN_UNSIGNED PASS, not signed; MEANING_OPEN computation PASS, meaning open; EMPTY_EXPECTED empty by design until a later day is built. Others: NO_CARD no reviewed card (meaning from the producer card); DRAFT the card is a draft; RULE_IN_CODE the rule is in code (nowread_v5); IN_FORCE the percent table rule in force (pct_rule_v2)

# NAME_STATUS: RENAMED renamed 18 Oct (card or register name); STANDING never renamed (its old name stands); NO_CARD_NAME the card names it none (a name from its meaning); NEW a lab v3 row (add-on, table, lab reading). BUILD: BUILT, BUILDING, PAUSED (its run stopped by the owner; days may be 0), PLANNED (no day yet), LEFT_OUT (its source is out of the year, the owner 12:55 Berlin)

# SEARCH: DEFAULT shown in an agent's default search; HIDDEN stored, shown only when asked: a rule-off copy (TWIN, the owner 13:06 Berlin), a value with no data (build LEFT_OUT), or a value not for analysis until its card is reviewed (use_may NONE)

column22: How many forced dollars there were per dollar of USDT taker selling (buying) in the minute: a ratio, not a bound either way. Three things move S01 to S04, one down and two up. A1 is a floor (the last print a coin a second), valued at the order's limit price: it pushes them down. The numerator holds the USDC contract's liquidations (16.98% and 14.60% of A1's long dollars on 8 Mar 2026 and 24 Sep 2025, J15877) while the denominator is USDT taker dollars only: it pushes them up, and the three values above 1 (all 8 Mar: BCH 07:00 S02 75.09, ENA 07:00 5.10, SHIB 19:38 S01 1.028) are USDC prints over USDT flow (J15875 a5look). A Tardis trade hole shrinks the denominator: it pushes them up too (FET 8 Mar 11:56: S01 0.171241 against 0.0788642 with the kline's taker selling; our taker sell 3,427.91 against the kline's 7,443.18; J15872 a5, J15875 a5look).
